Subject: Demo: Redwood inference overview

Hi Camila,

Thanks for reaching out earlier this week — GreenLeaf.ai is interested in exploring inference options for our recommendation engine. We're evaluating latency/cost tradeoffs and are particularly curious about Redwood's Dedicated offering and model routing features.

Would you have 30-45 minutes the week of Apr 5 to do a quick demo? Prefer mornings PT. I can bring Priya (engineering lead) as well.

Best,
Samir

Hi Samir — thanks, great to hear. Apr 8 or Apr 9 mornings PT are open on our side. I can do Apr 8 10:00 AM PT (30 minutes) and bring Marissa for product/contract questions and Lauren for deployment questions.

I attached a short deck that covers the architecture and typical cost/latency profiles so Priya has some context ahead of time. If that slot doesn't work, let me know a couple alternatives and we'll adjust.
